instruction: A dragonfly with four iridescent wings that shimmer through shifting rainbow interference, its slender segmented body plated in oil-slick holographic film. The veined wings scatter chromatic glints as they catch light, and the bulbous compound eyes gleam with prismatic sheen.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Holographic Dragonfly in a holographic style. A dragonfly with four iridescent wings that shimmer through shifting rainbow interference, its slender segmented body plated in oil-slick holographic film. The veined wings scatter chromatic glints as they catch light, and the bulbous compound eyes gleam with prismatic sheen. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
